headline: This law extends and expands the authority for the VA to replace its Denver, Colorado medical center by moving existing funds into a construction account.
what_it_does: It removes a FY2015 limit on the Denver VA medical center replacement project and raises the dollar amount authorized for it. It lets the VA transfer unspent FY2015 money from several VA accounts, such as medical services, facilities, cemeteries, and IT, into the Construction, Major Projects account to pay for the work. Transferred funds must be used by September 30, 2016.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans who receive care at the Denver VA medical center
who_it_affects.how: The law provides money to replace the existing Denver medical center, which may affect where and how they receive care during and after construction.

who_it_affects.group: Department of Veterans Affairs staff and offices in Denver and elsewhere
who_it_affects.how: Funds from several VA offices and programs are shifted to pay for the Denver project, reducing the money those accounts had available for their own planned uses.

when_it_takes_effect: Funds transferred under this Act must be used by September 30, 2016.
